checks.Description: M2F3-54 / M2F3-71 / M2F3-28 (fence): the real T2 on PostgreSQL 18. Server side (auto_explain; the runtime role logs no statements by product setting): the organization row lock, clock_timestamp() (after the lock), the catalogue check and the eight-row lookup, in that order, then exactly ONE INSERT into the journal and ONE UPDATE of the organization row (EF orders its batch) and nothing else. EF side (observing interceptor): SET LOCAL lock_timeout before the lock, SET LOCAL statement_timeout after it, one SaveChanges batch with the INSERT and the UPDATE, one commit. The UPDATE sets exactly the three permitted columns; no statement reads transaction_timestamp/now/current_timestamp/statement_timestamp; no statement touches content operations, the CARV floors or the data-key ledger
